year.note: Accepted manuscript does not state publication year.

summary: This is a review article, not a primary experimental study. It summarizes Ti3C2Tx supercapacitor electrodes reported in many externally cited publications, including porous architectures, carbon/polymer/metal-oxide composites, and surface-modified materials. No electrode materials were fabricated and electrochemically characterized by the review authors within this paper; therefore, cited literature samples and Table 1/Table 2 entries were excluded. Consequently, no distinct paper-specific electrodes can be extracted.
